title: Rabbit motif
subtitle: A flat applique rabbit face with long ear panels, 12 cm tall
excerpt: The rabbit motif builds a round dc head with two tall narrow ear panels worked upward from the head edge. The ears extend 5 cm above the head. At 12 cm tall in DK cotton it is one of the taller animal appliques in this set, working well as a centrepiece on baby blankets, Easter decorations, and tote bag panels.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from flat applique animal head construction. Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 8 (1893), Easter animal motif chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crochet rabbit face applique in white DK cotton with pink inner ear panels and a pink nose, 12 cm tall, photographed flat on a pale blue background in soft daylight. Two tall ears, clearly recognisable rabbit face.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 10 g of white DK cotton, 3 g of pink for inner ears. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Pink embroidery thread for nose. Black thread for eyes. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished rabbit motif measures 7 cm wide and 12 cm tall including ears in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.

Form a magic ring. Ch 1. Rnd 1: 6dc into ring. Sl st to join. (6 dc.) Rnd 2: 2dc in each dc. Sl st to join. (12 dc.) Rnd 3: *Dc. 2dc in next.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st to join. (18 dc.) Rnd 4: *Dc. Dc. 2dc in next.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st to join. (24 dc.)

Identify the top centre of the head. Count 3 dc to the left for the left ear base. Join yarn at that dc. Ch 5. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across chain. (4 dc.) Turn. *Ch 1. Dc across (4 dc). Turn.* Repeat 3 more times (5 rows of 4 dc total). Row 6 (tip): Ch 1. Dc2tog twice. (2 dc.) Fasten off. Re-join for the right ear at 3 dc to the right of centre; repeat ear.
In pink, ch 4. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across. (3 dc.) Work 4 rows of 3 dc. Final row: dc2tog, dc. (2 dc.) Fasten off. Sew inside each ear.

definition.title: Rabbit motif
definition.caption: 4-round magic ring head to 24dc. Ear: 5-row 4dc column with 2dc tip from the head border.

content.text: Embroider two small French knot eyes and a pink French knot nose. Sew the rabbit onto the base fabric through the head perimeter.
Handwash in cool water. Reshape ears while damp. Lay flat to dry.
The cat motif (crochet-animal-cat) uses the same head construction with shorter triangle ears. The fox motif (crochet-animal-fox) adds a more angular ear shape and a tail panel.
